delivery: U=1 reliable-delivery assumption; server choice recorded as A
decision_time: after the UTC day inventory summary exists, before local training
eligibility: P0 legal cell-slots; unknown spatial ids are rejected and are not mapped to index 0
warmup_meaning: vocabulary and scaler only; no optimizer warmup and no loaded checkpoint

scaler.source: recomputed from warmup train targets before use

local_loss: mean squared error on that client's legal records that day
batch: all legal records of the client that day, one forward per step
aggregation: theta_next = theta + eta * sum_j I_j * a_j * delta_j / p_j
delta_definition: theta_after_local - theta_before_local on the cloned snapshot; the plus sign then moves the server toward the local models

arms.B: region quota plus within-group quality PPS, w_j = n_j/N_g

history.prior: median of that region's client EMAs updated within 7 days, else 1

shared_uniform_start: B and C share u per date and region
evaluation: existing validation O=1, finite labels, spatial id inside the 118 warmup vocabulary; test is not used

feature_contract.trend_denominator: count of occupancy time slots at or before the end of the decision day; evaluation freezes the 2021-11-04 denominator

code_entries.sampler: P0 systematic sampler copied into the driver
code_entries.training: driver local SGD and HT aggregation
code_entries.scoring: driver endpoint evaluation after both arms finish 43 days
